entries.source: Exact and illustrated Water maps now show the same water budget.

drafts.zu: Ibalazwe Lamanzi elinembile nelinemidwebo manje abonisa isabelomali samanzi esifanayo.
drafts.st: Mmapa wa Metsi o nepahetseng le o nang le ditshwantsho jwale o bontsha tekanyetso e tshwanang ya metsi.
drafts.ts: Mepe wa Mati wa pulani ni wa xifaniso sweswi yi komba mpimanyeto wun’we wa mati.
drafts.ve: Mapa wa Maḓi wa pulane na wa tshifanyiso zwino u sumbedza mugaganyagwama muthihi wa maḓi.
